# Orqivium Code of Conduct

Orqivium contributors are expected to maintain a professional, respectful, technically rigorous environment.

Be constructive; critique work rather than people; disclose conflicts of interest; protect private data and security reports; credit actual authors; preserve upstream attribution; and avoid discriminatory, harassing, threatening, or deceptive behavior.

Project moderation and maintenance decisions are owned by **Kamran Ullah Afaq**. Serious conduct or security concerns should be reported privately through the repository host rather than posted publicly.
